+'use client'
+
+import { createContext, useContext, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
+
+type Theme = 'light' | 'dark'
+
+interface AppContextValue {
+  theme: Theme
+  setTheme: (theme: Theme) => void
+}
+
+const AppContext = createContext<AppContextValue | null>(null)
+
+interface AppProviderProps {
+  children: ReactNode
+}
+
+export function AppProvider({ children }: AppProviderProps) {
+  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<Theme>('light')
+
+  return (
+    <AppContext.Provider value={{ theme, setTheme }}>
+      {children}
+    </AppContext.Provider>
+  )
+}
+
+export function useAppContext(): AppContextValue {
+  const context = useContext(AppContext)
+
+  if (!context) {
+    throw new Error('useAppContext must be used within AppProvider')
+  }
+
+  return context
+}

+import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
+import type { LocalPost, UpdatePostBody } from '@/types'
+
+interface RouteContext {
+  params: Promise<{ id: string }>
+}
+
+export async function GET(
+  _request: NextRequest,
+  context: RouteContext
+): Promise<NextResponse<LocalPost>> {
+  const { id } = await context.params
+
+  const post: LocalPost = {
+    id: parseInt(id, 10),
+    title: `Post ${id}`,
+    content: `This is the content for post ${id}`,
+    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+  }
+
+  return NextResponse.json(post)
+}
+
+export async function PUT(
+  request: NextRequest,
+  context: RouteContext
+): Promise<NextResponse<LocalPost>> {
+  const { id } = await context.params
+  const body = (await request.json()) as UpdatePostBody
+  const { title, content } = body
+

Migration is complete. The `pages/` directory has been removed and everything now lives under the App Router with TypeScript types. The build passes.

## Migration Summary

### Pages → App Router

| Pages Router | App Router | Pattern |
|---|---|---|
| `pages/index.js` (SSR) | `app/page.tsx` | Async Server Component + `headers()` |
| `pages/blog/index.js` (ISR) | `app/blog/page.tsx` | `export const revalidate = 60` |
| `pages/blog/[id].js` (SSG + ISR) | `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` | `generateStaticParams` + `revalidate = 300` |
| `pages/404.js` | `app/not-found.tsx` | Built-in not-found handling |
| `pages/_error.js` | `app/error.tsx` | Error boundary (`'use client'`) |
| `pages/_app.js` + `_document.js` | `app/layout.tsx` | Root layout with `metadata` + `next/font` |

### API Routes → Route Handlers

| Pages Router | App Router |
|---|---|
| `pages/api/posts/index.js` | `app/api/posts/route.ts` |
| `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` |

### API Replacements

- **`next/head`** → `metadata` / `generateMetadata`
- **`next/router`** → `next/navigation` (`useRouter` in client components) and `Link`
- **`getServerSideProps`** → async Server Component with `headers()`
- **`getStaticProps` + `revalidate`** → `export const revalidate`
- **`getStaticPaths` + `fallback: 'blocking'`** → `generateStaticParams` (dynamic params enabled by default)
- **`notFound: true`** → `notFound()` from `next/navigation`
- **API `handler(req, res)`** → `GET`/`POST`/`PUT`/`DELETE` with `NextRequest`/`NextResponse`

### New typed modules

- `types/index.ts` — shared interfaces (`JsonPlaceholderPost`, `LocalPost`, etc.)
- `lib/jsonplaceholder.ts` — typed data-fetching helpers
- `components/AppProvider.tsx` — migrated to TypeScript with typed context
- `components/BackButton.tsx` — client component for `router.back()`
